user.title: Invite
user.description: Address the guests use to open Home Assistant. Invitation links start with it, so it must be reachable from where they open the email (home network, VPN or internet).

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL, starting with http:// or https://.

init.title: Invite options
init.description: Leave the SMTP server empty to share links yourself instead of emailing them. For Gmail use smtp.gmail.com, port 587, STARTTLS and an app password.

data.smtp_password: SMTP password (leave empty to keep the current one)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SMTP server.
error.invalid_auth: The SMTP server rejected the username or password.
error.sender_required: A sender address is required to send email.

create.name: Create invite
create.description: Creates a single-use link for someone to choose their own username and password. Emails it if an SMTP server is configured; otherwise shows it in a notification. The link is also returned as the action response.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the person; used for the user and the person.

expires_hours.name: Expires after
expires_hours.description: Hours until the link expires. Defaults to the integration option.

invite_id.name: Invite ID
invite_id.description: ID returned when the invite was created, or listed by the List invites action.

list.name: List invites
list.description: Returns pending and past invitations (without their links).

not_loaded.message: The Invite integration is not loaded.

invite_not_found.message: There is no invite with ID {invite_id}.
